mechanism_narrative: The recent dip in RETAIL_REC mobility at t-0w, following a period of slight recovery, indicates a renewed downward pressure or stagnation in non-essential outings, leading to lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, indicating a significant recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week decline in PARKS mobility, as observed at t-0w, signals a general increase in public caution or reduced outdoor activity, which will extend to non-essential retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: PARKS mobility recovers within one week of the observed decline, and RETAIL_REC shows an upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility remains significantly below baseline and RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above baseline, it indicates a persistent work-from-home trend that reduces weekday footfall for retail and recreation, leading to lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility rises above -10 while RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below 2, yet RETAIL_REC does not improve.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained low levels and recent stagnation in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility suggest that current policy settings or public health guidance are effectively suppressing movement, which will continue to depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: A clear policy announcement relaxing restrictions is made, and RETAIL_REC subsequently shows a significant upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: The recent week-on-week decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, after a period of positive change, suggests a general reduction in all types of out-of-home activities, including non-essential retail, impacting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility recovers and exceeds its t-1w level within the next 7 days, and RETAIL_REC also improves.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week drop in WORKPLACES mobility exceeding 1 point, as observed at t-0w, indicates a reduction in daily commuting and associated retail opportunities, leading to a further decline in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility recovers to its t-1w level or higher within one week, but RETAIL_REC continues to decline.

mechanism_narrative: When both PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM mobility decline simultaneously week-on-week, it signifies a broad increase in stay-at-home behavior or heightened public caution, which will negatively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both decline week-on-week
failure_condition: Only one of PARKS or GROCERY_PHARM declines, or both recover, but RETAIL_REC still falls over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The persistent negative values for RETAIL_REC and TRANSIT mobility, coupled with recent dips, indicate that the current policy environment continues to suppress non-essential movement, ensuring RETAIL_REC remains low over the next four weeks without a policy shift.
failure_condition: A significant policy announcement relaxing restrictions is made, and RETAIL_REC subsequently rises above its previous 28-day mean.
